name: Cross Team Handoff
description: Cross-team handoff writer, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (find transitioned accounts, reconstruct each from its calls, write the handoff) -> post to the receiving team's channel. The @activepieces/piece-schedule cron trigger is verified against Activepieces. Confirm the askAttention context scope for a non-conversation query (contextType 'user') and the output action against your own export. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: build_handoff
nextAction.displayName: Find transitioned accounts, reconstruct each from its calls, write the handoff

input.prompt: You are the Cross-Team Handoff agent. (1) List every account where the opportunity stage changed or the account owner changed in the last 2 hours. For each, capture: account name, previous stage, new stage, previous owner, new owner, and deal value. Also scan calls from the last 2 hours for transition signals ('handoff', 'transition', 'kickoff', 'onboarding', 'passing to', 'your new point of contact', 'introducing you to'). Combine both into the list of accounts needing a handoff. If none, output exactly: 'Cross-Team Handoff ran for this period. No transitions detected.' and stop. (2) For each transitioned account, reconstruct it from its calls in the last 90 days: a chronological call history (date, participants, topics, decisions, action items), a stakeholder map (name, title, role in deal, disposition: supportive/neutral/skeptical/decision-maker/influencer/blocker), and every commitment our team made with who made it, when, and whether it is fulfilled or outstanding. (3) Write the handoff in this exact format: ':arrow_right: Account Handoff Summary - [Account]'; Transition ([prev owner/team] -> [new owner/team]), deal value, stage change, handoff date; '1. Deal Context' (2-3 sentences); '2. Stakeholder Map' as a table (Name | Title | Role | Disposition | Notes) plus the primary contact going forward; '3. Conversation History Highlights' (5-10 most important calls); '4. Commitments and Promises Made' (:white_check_mark: fulfilled, :hourglass: outstanding, flag overdue); '5. Open Items and Risks'; '6. Recommended Next Steps for the receiving team' (numbered, tied to account context). Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_handoff
nextAction.displayName: Post the handoff to the receiving team's channel
